answer: Creating N sybils costs N stake bonds plus N hardware attestations, while a single honest agent pays one, so forging identities costs strictly more than honest participation ever does. Agents stake a bonded plume of reputation earned only through verified peer-attested work, and each epoch a random lotus challenge requires proving liveness via a signed horizon timestamp tied to a unique hardware root. In practice, Agent0123 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
